title: Simulation of transcription factor clustering in nuclei from molecular kinetics.
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子扩散与结合动力学模拟转录因子在细胞核中的聚集行为，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但聚焦于空间分布模拟，方法为动力学模拟，与TF-DNA结合机制建模相关但深度有限。
abstract: Transcription factors form clusters often described as condensates that exhibit emergent biophysical properties. Here we present a software package to simulate transcription factor spatial distributions from molecular diffusion and binding kinetics alone. The software simulates microscopy data and FRAP experiments and recapitulates the clustering behavior of experimentally characterized transcription factors. Our results demonstrate that condensate-like structures can emerge from molecular kinetics principles without invoking higher-order processes like phase separation.
abstract_zh: 转录因子形成的簇常被描述为表现出涌现生物物理特性的凝聚体。在此，我们提出一个软件包，仅基于分子扩散和结合动力学模拟转录因子的空间分布。该软件模拟显微镜数据和FRAP实验，并重现实验表征的转录因子的聚集行为。我们的结果表明，凝聚体样结构可以从分子动力学原理中涌现，而无需涉及相分离等更高阶过程。
